title: The Fourth, 2003
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Gully's first Fourth as a shop. The dock is full. Wood gives up his spot on the edge.

panels.composition: The dock, night, fireworks white on black — and full of people for the first time: townspeople with paper cups, on the dock, on the shack's steps. GULLY at the door pouring. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY, not at the edge.

image.prompt: a wooden dock at night crowded with townspeople holding paper cups under white fireworks, a young man in an apron pouring coffee at a shack's door, another young man sitting on the steps with a small dog, high-contrast black and white

panels.composition: Wood, looking at the edge of the dock where he used to sit. Two kids sitting there.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man looking toward the end of a crowded dock where two children sit with their feet over the water

panels.composition: Gully, sitting down beside him on the steps for one minute. The lawn chair under the eave, empty as ever.

balloons.text: It was never my spot. It was the dock's.

image.prompt: two young men sitting side by side on shack steps at night with a small dog, an empty lawn chair beside them, fireworks light on their faces

panels.composition: The finale. The full dock. The chair. The two on the steps. The fireworks not red.

image.prompt: a wide fireworks finale over a bay in white on black, a crowded dock, a shack with two figures on its steps and an empty lawn chair, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white
